prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1492; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the facts, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That works. Can you describe where you were coming from and where you were headed when the collision happened?

A: I was driving home from a errand near the shopping center. I was heading toward my neighborhood and needed to turn left at the intersection with the traffic light.

Q: What was the signal showing when you approached the intersection?

A: It was green for my direction, but the left arrow had not turned on yet. I was waiting for a gap in the oncoming traffic before I went through.

Q: Tell me what happened next.

A: An oncoming vehicle came through while I was already partway into the turn. Its front end hit the driver's side of my car. I felt the impact and the airbags went off. I remember trying to brace myself against the steering wheel with my left hand.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: My left wrist was hurting badly right away. Paramedics checked me and I was taken to the hospital. I was told later that the wrist was fractured.

Q: Has the wrist been treated since then?

A: Yes, it was set and put in a splint. I have a follow-up with a specialist and I'm still wearing the cast.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was careful and I believe the other driver should have yielded. That's all I have to say.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the statement.
